description: Master Plan 2019 SDCP Building Height Control layer (GEOJSON) is a dataset listed in Singapore open data portal (data.gov.sg), an open data portal, published or maintained by Urban Redevelopment Authority. Indicative polygon of the Building Height Control layer in the Building Height Control Plan. Landed Housing Area Plan is a Special and Detailed Control Plan (SDCP) which provides guidelines and controls for specific area of development. (Info superseded by DMP25 in June 2025). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source.
